claims.claim_text: Architected governed agentic systems using L0 route-policy dispatch and runtime proof bundle lineage to deliver a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows.
Built CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, aligning enterprise workflow adoption with revenue and renewal priorities.
Established runtime resilience controls and context engineering practices that delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows.
Standardized managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design, compressing the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks.
Engineered cloud data and runtime integration patterns across Databricks Lakehouse, vector services, and API gateways to support distributed AI execution infrastructure.
Led AI platform commercialization and agentic platform productization, scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28 while building a reusable IT strategy and innovation operating model.
